content_zh:
凶虎眯着眼，飞速的扫视着。
这里没有客厅卧室厨房之分，逼仄的长条形房间内，勉强能放下一张床和柜子，其他东西都必须堆在一旁，否则根本没有地方放。
连洗手间都没有。
这样的居住环境，在贫民窟也算是下等的。
在凶虎的对面，一个人斜斜的靠坐在窗户边，正是地下杀手团伙的头头。
其他人都不在，目标也不在。
倒是有些小聪明，可惜他们不明白，在绝对的实力面前，这种小聪明只会加深自己的痛苦。
凶虎大步走上去，一把抓住对方的脖子，拎起对方道：“垃圾，交出那小子，否则我保证你们全都会死的很惨。”
对方狠狠的瞪着他，没有说话。
凶虎眉头一扬，就准备给对方点苦头。
忽然，一股不好的感觉涌上心头。
凶虎突然回过身来，全身肌肉一阵蠕动，整个人身形都变得更高更壮。
——几乎是一瞬间，他就变成了一个身高三米左右的魁梧巨人！
“喝！”
凶虎爆发出一声搏命的吼叫，双手往空气中狠狠一拍。
一道沉闷的响声传来，凶虎身子一仰，蹬蹬连退几步，狠狠撞在窗户旁边的墙上。
墙都被他撞裂了一条缝。
凶虎低下头，凝视着自己的双手。
“弓箭？真是难得一见的东西。”凶虎看着手中紧紧握着的箭矢，若有所思道。
他猛的抬头望去，只见黑暗中，一道身影站在门口，手中举着一张古朴的长弓。

“你是……那个穷学生？！”
凶虎认出来人，心中无比的惊骇。
刚才那一箭，他也是用了全力才抵挡住。
这样的箭术确实不凡，根本不是一个高中生该有的水平。
不行，必须立刻开展近身肉搏，才有机会杀掉对方！
想到这里，凶虎双脚一蹬，整个人轰然往前冲去。
顾青山也同时动了！
又是一箭！
这一箭瞄准了胸腹，凶虎在急速的冲锋中，根本来不及躲避。
他不得不再次伸出双手，狠狠往空气中一拍。
啪的一声。
箭矢被他拍飞，但他也被箭矢上强劲的冲击力带着往后推了两步。
但凶虎却毫不在意的咧嘴一笑。
“这一箭威力确实不错，但以你这样单薄的身体，恐怕已经拉不开弓了吧。”
凶虎活动了一下脖子，嘲弄道：“你还能发出几次这样的攻击？”
顾青山略一停顿，道：“唔，很多次啊。”
说话的同时，他拉开弓。
两人之间仿佛出现了一道道灰色的闪电，从顾青山处，往凶虎身上奔袭而去。
凶虎靠着墙壁，用尽全力招架。
逼仄的房间根本无法躲闪。

箭矢上强大的冲击力，几乎赶得上武道宗师的全力一击，他若放弃不管，必定是箭矢贯穿身体的下场。
凶虎真的没想到，身为武道宗师的自己，居然被一个高中小子压着打。
而且这狼狈的景象，还通过全息视频影像，传输到了大公子那边。
“该死的小子，你杀不了我的，等你箭矢用完，就是你的死期。”凶虎怒喝道。
顾青山手上不停，道：“你等不到那个时候了，再见。”
他引导着丹田中的灵力，完全灌注在箭矢上。
嘶嘶嘶！
箭矢呼啸而去，沿途的空气都发出摩擦后的哀鸣声。
这一箭直接打散了凶虎的双手，扑的一声，没入他的胸口。
凶虎背靠的墙壁不堪冲击，轰然裂开，翻滚着从22层的高度抛飞出去。
整面墙都掉落下去，凶虎背后只有不停吹拂的夜风，再也没有可以依靠的东西。
“该死！”
凶虎努力掌握平衡，想要再次稳住身形。
然而让他绝望的是，又有一箭呼啸着飞来。
这凶猛的一箭，终于裹着凶虎飞出了22层的高楼，从高空中划过一道抛物线，远远落了下去。
别说宗师，就算是大宗师，从22楼这样的高度落下去，也是必死无疑。
除非到了武尊境界，一身金钢铁骨不惧巨大的冲击力，才能活下来。
顾青山走到凶虎原先站立的地方，捡起掉在地上的通讯器。
“聂云？”
通讯器中传来聂云阴沉的声音：“你杀我家的供奉的时候，有没有想过，我会为你再准备什么？”

顾青山看了看通讯器中的画面，忽然道：“你那边好像是市区内最大的那家赌场，这样的话，可不可以请你待在原地不要动？”
聂云一愣：“什么意思。”

content_en:
Fierce Tiger squinted his eyes and scanned quickly.
There is no living room, bedroom, or kitchen here. The long and cramped room can barely fit a bed and a cabinet. All other things must be piled aside, otherwise there will be no place to put them.
There isn't even a restroom.
This kind of living environment is considered inferior even in slums.
Opposite the fierce tiger, a man was sitting leaning against the window. He was the leader of the underground killer gang.
No one else is there, and neither is the target.
There is some cleverness, but unfortunately they don't understand that in the face of absolute strength, this kind of cleverness will only deepen their pain.
Fierce Tiger strode up, grabbed the opponent's neck, picked him up and said: "Trash, hand over that kid, otherwise I guarantee that you will all die miserably."
The other party stared at him fiercely and said nothing.
Fierce Tiger raised his brows, ready to give the other party a hard time.
Suddenly, a bad feeling came over me.
Fierce Tiger suddenly turned around, his muscles all over his body squirmed, and his entire body became taller and stronger.
——Almost instantly, he turned into a burly giant about three meters tall!
"Drink!"
The fierce tiger burst out with a desperate roar and slapped his hands into the air.
A dull sound came, and the ferocious tiger leaned up, took a few steps back, and hit the wall next to the window hard.
The wall was cracked by him.
Fierce Tiger lowered his head and stared at his hands.
"Bow and arrow? It's really a rare thing." Fierce Tiger looked at the arrow tightly held in his hand and said thoughtfully.
He looked up suddenly and saw a figure standing at the door in the darkness, holding a simple long bow in his hand.
"Are you...that poor student?!"
Fierce Tiger recognized the person and felt extremely horrified.
He had used all his strength to block the arrow just now.
Such archery skills are indeed extraordinary, not at the level that a high school student should have.
No, you must start a close combat immediately to have a chance to kill the opponent!
Thinking of this, Fierce Tiger kicked his feet and rushed forward.
Gu Qingshan also moved at the same time!
Another arrow!
This arrow was aimed at the chest and abdomen. The fierce tiger had no time to dodge in the rapid charge.
He had no choice but to stretch out his hands again and punch the air hard.
There was a snap.
The arrow was knocked away by him, but he was also pushed back two steps by the strong impact of the arrow.
But Fierce Tiger grinned indifferently.
"The power of this arrow is indeed good, but with a body as thin as yours, I'm afraid you won't be able to draw the bow."
Fierce Tiger moved its neck and mocked: "How many more times can you attack like this?"
Gu Qingshan paused for a moment and said, "Well, many times."
As he spoke, he drew his bow.
Gray lightning seemed to appear between the two of them, rushing towards the fierce tiger from Gu Qingshan.
The fierce tiger leaned against the wall and tried his best to parry.
There was no way to dodge in the cramped room.
The powerful impact of the arrow was almost as strong as a martial arts master's full blow. If he gave up and ignored it, the arrow would pierce his body.
Fierce Tiger really didn't expect that as a martial arts master, he would be pressed down and beaten by a high school kid.
Moreover, this embarrassing scene was transmitted to the eldest son through holographic video images.
"Damn boy, you can't kill me. When you run out of arrows, you will die." Fierce Tiger shouted angrily.
Gu Qingshan kept his hands on his hands and said, "You can't wait until that time. Goodbye."
He guided the spiritual power in his Dantian and poured it completely into the arrow.
Hiss!
The arrow whizzed away, and the air along the way made a whining sound after friction.
This arrow directly scattered the fierce tiger's hands and plunged into his chest.
The wall against which the ferocious tiger was backed could not withstand the impact, cracked open, and rolled and was thrown from the height of the 22nd floor.
The whole wall fell downFalling down, there is only the night wind blowing behind the fierce tiger, and there is nothing to rely on anymore.
"Damn it!"
Fierce Tiger tried hard to master his balance, trying to stabilize his body again.
However, what made him despair was that another arrow whizzed towards him.
This ferocious arrow finally flew out of the 22-story high-rise building wrapped in the ferocious tiger, drew a parabola from the sky, and fell far away.
Not to mention a grandmaster, even a great grandmaster would definitely die if he fell from a height as high as the 22nd floor.
Only those who have reached the realm of Martial Lord, with a body of gold and steel that is not afraid of huge impact, can survive.
Gu Qingshan walked to where Fierce Tiger was standing and picked up the communicator that fell on the ground.
"Nie Yun?"
Nie Yun's gloomy voice came from the communicator: "When you killed my family's worshipers, did you ever think about what I would prepare for you?"
Gu Qingshan looked at the picture in the communicator and suddenly said: "Your place seems to be the largest casino in the city. In this case, can you please stay where you are and don't move?"
Nie Yun was stunned: "What do you mean?"
